title: Open direct-image comparison intertwines pinned counits
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $V\subset Y$ open, $U=f^{-1}V$, $f_0:U\to V$ its restriction, and $K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $R_X,R_Y$ be exact derived open restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], $b_f:Rf_*\mathbin{\star}R_Y\cong R_X\mathbin{\star}Rf_{0*}$ the fixed sectionwise-derived comparison [def-pc-n3-open-base-change-comparisons], and $d_f:R_Y\mathbin{\star}Lf_0^*\cong Lf^*\mathbin{\star}R_X$ the constructed open pullback square [def-pc-t2-open-pullback-square-iso], where the star denotes functor sequencing (left factor first). For the adjunctions pinned to the left-derived composition counits [def-pc-derived-base-change-map], $Lf_0^*(b_f(K))\gg\epsilon_{f_0}(R_XK)=d_f(Rf_*K)\gg R_X(\epsilon_f(K))$. There is no base-change square or comparison of base-change arrows in this assertion.

proof.text: Use the open direct-image unit identity and counit naturality to move exact restriction past the restricted counit. Reuse the shared pinned counit normalization singleComplexOpen_pinned_counit_unit instead of the former private duplicate, obtaining Qh of the sectionwise counit after the left-derived counit.

The pullback-square representative identity evaluates the other composite to the same morphism. On a K-injective complex the right-derived unit is an isomorphism, so the representative map t and its pullback image are isomorphisms. Cancel this image to obtain equality on Qh of every K-injective complex.

Every derived object is isomorphic to Q of a K-injective complex by the existing DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isKInjective theorem. Convert Q to Qh using quotientCompQhIso. Assemble both composites as natural transformations, apply their naturality to the representing isomorphism, and cancel its image under exact restriction. This proves the original statement for every K.

lean.statement: theorem singleComplexOpen_counit_compatibility [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (V : Y.Opens) (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) : let a := @singleComplexOpenPinnedAdjunction.{u, w} _ let RX := (schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapDerivedCategory (derivedPullback (f ∣_ V)).map ((singleComplexOpenDirectImageIso f V).hom.app K) ≫ (a (f ∣_ V)).counit.app (RX.obj K) = (singleComplexOpenPullbackSquareIso f V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (f ∣_ V) (morphismRestrict_ι f V)).hom.app ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj K) ≫ RX.map ((a f).counit.app K)
